_doc: GENERATED by scripts/native/gen-placement.mjs from web/js/placement.js (Placement.posterior/estimate/bandOf/cefrOf/stageOf/nextLevel/take run in node:vm; record = the settings.placement literal of the route). resp item {kind: vocab|grammar, lv, r: right|wrong|idk, c: chance of a lucky guess | absent = 0.25}. take: rnd = the values returned by successive rnd() calls. scenarios: the ask() loop over content-pack/placement-bank.json with rnd = LCG (x = x*1664525+1013904223 mod 2^32, value = x/2^32, seed first): kind = vocab for even index, grammar for odd; want = nextLevel(answers of that kind); c = 0.25 for vocabulary, 1/options for grammar; policy decides the answer (right|wrong|idk|alt = right on even index|ladder = right at A2/B1|mix = idk every 3rd, else ladder).
